meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分镜、节拍和字幕脚本渲染成视频成片,本地或云端都能出片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把脚本和分镜做成可渲染的视频成片,并需要本地或云端批量产出。
copy.tagline_en: Turn storyboards, beats and captions into finished videos, local or cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you turn scripts and storyboards into rendered video, locally or in the cloud

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 系列命令帮你搭建项目、编写合成、跑 lint 和 check 检查、开预览,并在你确认后渲染出视频文件,也能排查构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你要求用 HyperFrames 搭建、检查、预览或渲染合成项目,或需要排查构建与渲染失败时触发;非交互环境下 init 需带 --example。

say.text: 用 hyperframes init 建个项目,再跑一次 check
say.note: 会生成项目骨架并执行最终检查

say.text: 先在 catalog 里搜「逐行出现标题」的动效
say.note: catalog 只在本地搜索,不发送查询

say.text: check 通过后开预览,等我确认再渲染成 mp4
say.note: 预览保持运行,渲染前会先等你同意

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs npx hyperframes commands to scaffold a project, author compositions, run lint/check, open a preview, render a video after approval, and diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build, check, preview, or render a HyperFrames composition project, or when diagnosing build and render failures; in non-TTY mode init needs --example.

say_en.text: Scaffold a project with hyperframes init, then run check
say_en.note: Creates the project skeleton and runs the final check

say_en.text: Search the catalog for a one-line-at-a-time headline reveal
say_en.note: Catalog search stays local and sends nothing

say_en.text: After check passes, open the preview and wait for my approval before rendering
say_en.note: Preview stays alive until you approve the render
